providers.favorite: Star this provider (pins it to the top)
providers.pinned_hint: Pin a favorite model from this provider's model list

bulk.title: Bulk-add providers
bulk.desc: One shared endpoint + a list of API keys (one per line). Keys duplicating an existing provider are skipped.

ckey.title: CKey (ckey.vn)
ckey.desc: View your account, usage stats and import models from CKey into the OpenCode config.
ckey.key_hint: The account key manages your ckey.vn account (stats, deposits, AI keys). It is stored in ckey.json and never written to opencode.json.
ckey.deposit_bad_amount: Please enter a valid amount (minimum 1,000 VND).
ckey.no_profiles: No CKey account saved yet — add one with the account key from the Profile page on ckey.vn.
ckey.lbl_profile_key: Account key (from Profile page on ckey.vn)
ckey.profile_key_required: Please paste the account key from your ckey.vn Profile page.
ckey.change_key_placeholder: Paste a new key to replace…
ckey.delete_profile_confirm_msg: The saved account will be removed. Providers already imported keep their models and keys.
ckey.auto_refresh_hint: Auto-refreshes every minute via cache (no request flood); use Refresh to force reload.
ckey.force_refresh_hint: Bypass cache and fetch fresh data
ckey.price_unit_hint: The catalog is global (same for all CKey accounts) and lists "provider/model" entries. In/Out/Cache: VND per 1M tokens · Per-request: fixed charge (≥ = minimum) · click headers to sort.
ckey.import_none_selected_confirm: No models selected — applying will REMOVE all current models of the target provider. Continue?

provider_modal.npm_hint: Auto reads the model catalog, then sends a small probe to Responses, Chat, and Anthropic, saving the first protocol that succeeds. If the catalog or probes are blocked, choose manually.
provider_modal.url_hint: You can paste a full endpoint — it is trimmed back to the root (e.g. /v1/chat/completions → /v1).
provider_modal.key_hint: Keys go to auth.json for built-in presets, or opencode.json for custom providers.
provider_modal.id_hint_add: Leave empty to auto-generate. Only letters, digits, "_" and "-". Must be unique.
provider_modal.id_hint_edit: Change the ID to rename this provider (models and settings are kept). Must be unique.
provider_modal.id_invalid: ID may only contain letters, digits, "_" and "-" (1–64 chars).
provider_modal.dup_msg: Another provider already uses this Base URL and API Key. Merge into it?
provider_modal.conflict_msg: This endpoint is the same as the built-in provider below. Keeping a separate custom provider duplicates that endpoint (same API, two entries). Save anyway?
provider_modal.keep_key: Leave empty to keep the current key.

models.title: Models of
models.stale_warning: These models are still in your config but the provider NO LONGER offers them. They are unticked by default and will be REMOVED when you apply — tick to keep them.
models.matrix_desc: All models from your providers: capabilities, limits and pricing in one table. Star a model to make it the primary model OpenCode uses by default.
models.primary_need_sync: Sync the model into the provider first, then set it as primary
models.matrix_none: No models match the current filters (or no provider has models yet).
models.matrix_legend: — = not declared (OpenCode uses the model default) · ✓/✗ = declared in your config · ≈ = name-based estimate (config > models.dev > name) · prices from the local models.dev cache (USD per 1M tokens), click headers to sort.
models.enriched_hint: Rows enriched with data from the local models.dev cache
models.arbiter_pick_hint: The arbiter evaluates the collected data and assigns 0-100 scores. It never takes the test itself.
models.arbiter_hint: Each run is stored (max 5). Final score = median of the last runs, so one odd assessment can't skew the result; "volatile" means the scores haven't converged yet — run more times.
models.arbiter_none: No evaluations yet — pick an arbiter and run "Evaluate".
models.arbiter_legend: Scores 0-100 from the arbiter model (evaluates metadata, not live tests) · safety freedom: 100 means least/no restriction, — means unknown · run 1 = its own result; run N = median of the last ≤5 runs · Ctx/Out = arbiter's believed limits (⚠ = disagrees with config/models.dev) · click headers to sort.
models.sync_limits_hint: Overwrite context/output limits of mismatched models with models.dev values (capabilities are kept)
models.sync_limits_confirm: Overwrite the context/output limits of the mismatched models with the models.dev values? Other settings (capabilities, prices) are not touched. Mismatched models:
models.apply_none_selected_confirm: No models selected — applying will REMOVE all current models of this provider. Continue?
models.arb_limits_hint: Limits as believed by the arbiter — ⚠ when it disagrees with your config / models.dev by more than 25%
models.rec_none: No models to rank yet for this task.
models.rec_need_judge: Run the arbiter first (panel above) — rankings are judge-driven, not spec-reading.
models.rec_unevaluated: Models not yet judged (excluded from ranking)
models.rec_legend: score /base: total vs the judge's raw score for this task · adjustments are bounded modifiers (context ±10, tools +3, price ≤ -40) so a small-context specialist still beats a big-context weak generalist · S ≥ 85 top tier, A ≥ 75, B ≥ 60.
models.web_no_url: Start the web service to get a localhost URL
models.terminal_hint: Launch an independent, visible OpenCode terminal

cleanup.title: Clean up failing providers
cleanup.desc: Test every provider and suggest removing the ones that do not work.
cleanup.delete_confirm_msg: Delete every selected provider? This cannot be undone.
